page.overview:
Who is Brett Warnewagen?

Brett Warnewagen is a minor character in Cars 2. He is a van residing in London. He is a red Citroën HY.

He is one of the many characters seen clobbering Acer and Grem after they crash into the Ye Left Turn Inn.
